title: The team leader sets the urgency, and the due date follows
description: When approving a client request, the team leader picks Urgent or Non-urgent instead of typing a delivery date. The due date is that many working days from approval and cannot be edited. The team is measured against it, not against the client's ideal date.
items: Each form sets its own working days: Urgent 3 and Non-urgent 5 by default
The urgency can be changed later on the request, and the due date moves with it
The client's ideal finish date is shown for context
pending: Needs the P16 database updates applied before it works.
